metadata.subtitle: IX. Fugue in E major (a 4): Ricercar in circulo
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (guest subject: J. S. Bach, BWV 878, after J. C. F. Fischer)

subject_entries.label: Subject (E), alto, front left: alone, as Spem begins
Answer (B), tenor, front right
Subject (E), bass, back right
Guest: J. S. Bach's BWV 878 subject (after Fischer) in Bach's answer form, soprano, back left
Subject (E), tenor, under the guest
Inversion (c#), soprano, back left: alone after the silence
Inversion (f#), bass, back right
Inversion (A, cadencing in E), tenor, front right
Inversion (E), alto, front left: where the subject began
Antiphony L1: subject (A), soprano; left half alone
Antiphony R1: guest, BWV 878 subject at Bach's pitch (E), bass; right half alone
Antiphony L2: head of the subject (B), alto
Antiphony R2: head of the guest (c#), bass
Antiphony L3: head (A), soprano
Antiphony R3: head of the guest (f#), bass
Antiphony L4: rising fourth (head), alto
Antiphony R4: the guest's 1-2-4, tenor
Guest as cantus: BWV 878 subject in augmentation (x2), soprano (its last E5 is b54.1)
Final stretto 1: subject (on E), alto, front left
Final stretto 2: subject (E), tenor, front right, half a bar later
Final stretto 3: subject (E), bass, back right, at its exposition pitch
Coda: subject (on E), soprano: the cantus's last note becomes the subject's first
